name: Basilisk
description: A serpent-like beast whose gaze is said to turn the unwary to stone.

name: Blink Dog
description: A small, quick hound that vanishes and reappears a few steps away.

name: Blood Elk
description: A large deer with a red coat and antlers that are sharp enough to kill.

name: Cave Locust
description: A giant insect that swarms in the dark places underground.

name: Cobblehounds
description: Hounds made of stone and rubble that guard ruins on their masters' orders.

name: Creeping Vines
description: A tangle of thorned vines that grows over anything still for long enough.

name: Grizzly Bear
description: A huge bear with long claws, cross and quick to defend its territory.

name: Killer Bees
description: A swarm of bees whose stings are far more dangerous than an ordinary bee's.

name: Night Cat
description: A large, black-furred cat that hunts only after dark.

name: Traitor-Rats
description: Rats that have turned on their keepers and move as one seething mass of teeth.

name: Viper
description: A venomous snake that strikes from cover in the undergrowth.

name: Wolf
description: A grey wolf that hunts in packs and fights to pull down its prey.
